_comment: Copy this to tools/health/config.json (gitignored) and tune. The webhook URL may also be supplied via $AGENTARMY_HEALTH_WEBHOOK_URL so it never lands in git.

twilio._channel_note: 'sms' (metered; US delivery needs A2P 10DLC registration) or 'whatsapp' (Twilio WhatsApp sandbox/sender — no carrier registration; recipient must first join the sandbox; 'from' is the sandbox number, e.g. +14155238886).
twilio._authToken: Auth token via $AGENTARMY_TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN (sourced from KV secret 'Twilio') — preferred; or set authToken here (config.json is gitignored). criticalOnly=true keeps metered SMS to critical alerts only.
